scoring_justification: The hidden checker extracts the headline thermodynamic quantities from the agent's raw simulation CSV files (phase diagram, T0, Ms, enthalpy, stress rate) and compares them against paper‑reported values with per‑quantity tolerances; no self‑reported metrics are trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for B2 congruent melting point, B2 Ti‑rich solubility boundary, T0 at two compositions, Ms at two compositions, transformation enthalpy at equiatomic composition, stress rate at 6% strain.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'New modelling of the B2 phase and its associated martensitic transformation in the Ti–Ni system', Acta Materialia 47 (1999) 3457‑3468.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted numerical values directly from the paper: melting point 1585 K (Section 4.1), maximum Ti solubility 50.5 at.% at 1400 K ⇒ x_Ni = 0.495 (Fig. 7), T0 = 366.5 K at equivatomic composition and ≈ 340 K at x_Ni = 0.505 (Section 4.2, Fig. 12), Ms = 333 K at 50 at.% Ni and ≈ 230 K at 50.6 at.% Ni (Section 4.3, Fig. 13), ΔH = 1672 J/mol at 50 at.% Ni (Section 4.4), stress rate ≈ 6.3 MPa/K for 6% strain at x_Ni = 0.498 (Fig. 15).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, serving as the hidden reference for reproduction; they are not invented holdout labels.

outputs.description: Phase boundary coordinates of the Ti‑Ni system. The checker extracts key features (congruent melting point, solubility limits) and compares them to the paper's reported values.
T0 temperature vs. Ni content. The checker extracts T0 at specific compositions and compares to paper values.
Martensite start temperature vs. Ni content. The checker extracts Ms at key compositions and compares to paper values.
Transformation enthalpy vs. Ni content. The checker reads the value at equiatomic composition and compares to the paper.
Stress rate vs. Ni content for 6% and 8% strain. The checker extracts a value at a specific composition and compares to the paper.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are computed using the model parameters given in the Appendix. The checker extracts key scalar values from these CSV files and compares them against the paper's reported numbers with per‑quantity tolerances.

solubility_1400K.description: B2 Ti‑rich boundary Ni mole fraction at 1400 K
